title: John Fetterman’s Popularity With Republicans Surges, Poll Finds
summary: Pennsylvania Republicans now view John Fetterman, the state’s Democratic senator, more favorably than its sitting G.O.P. senator, a New York Times/Philadelphia Inquirer/Siena poll found.
